name: kwench
title: Kwench
description: Chat with KWENCH bot to book meeting rooms and manage workspace resources
author: ebeloded

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask KWENCH
commands.description: Chat with KWENCH bot to manage workspace bookings

tools.name: chat
tools.title: Chat with KWENCH
tools.description: Send a message to the KWENCH bot to book meeting rooms, check availability, list bookings, or cancel reservations

ai.instructions: You are helping users interact with the KWENCH workspace booking system. Use the chat tool to send messages to KWENCH for: booking meeting rooms, phone booths, or resident booths; checking availability of spaces; listing existing bookings; canceling reservations. Always use natural language when talking to KWENCH - it understands requests like 'book a meeting room tomorrow at 2pm' or 'what rooms are available this afternoon'.

evals.input: @kwench book a meeting room tomorrow at 2pm

mocks.chat: I've booked Meeting Room A for you tomorrow from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM.

evals.input: @kwench what rooms are available this afternoon?

mocks.chat:
Here are the available meeting rooms for this afternoon:
- Meeting Room A: 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM
- Meeting Room B: 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM

You have the following upcoming bookings:
1. Meeting Room A - Tomorrow 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM
I've cancelled your booking for Meeting Room A tomorrow at 2:00 PM.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
